registration_phase: before solver/oracle warmup and every timed run

design.maps: 18 distinct maps: 3 open, 3 snakes, 6 independent DFS mazes, 6 independent Bernoulli p=.25 maps; sizes41/61/81
design.queries: 64 distinct ordered pairs sampled from all passable cells, unfiltered by reachability; counts use shared prefixes
design.primary: per-map paired total delta corridor_low_h minus grid_low_h; matched identity_low_h isolates graph reduction
design.strong_baseline: existing k=1 landmark with low_h, plus compression x landmark 2x2 within the same macro-search kernel
design.timing: whole independent build + terminal insertion + search + full path reconstruction; split times descriptive, total is primary
design.blocks: seeded shuffled workload/count tasks and seeded shuffled variants within each block; serial execution; default interpreter GC
design.warmup: one complete 64-query batch per variant/map, after registration; discarded
design.oracle: independent BFS costs and full path validation outside timing; every timed result validated afterward
design.interpretation: 7 timing repetitions are not 7 independent maps; IQR describes repeats, not a confidence interval; retain all losses
design.break_even: first tested query count with paired median below zero; descriptive sampled boundary, not exact threshold or guaranteed monotonicity
design.scope: static four-direction unit grid only; original formal solver remains unchanged
